source.title: Design and prototyping of PCB stator electric motor with FDM 3D printed parts
source.authors: E. Collijs, R. Vereecken (supervisor P. Sergeant)

applies.note: yes (ignores vias, corner rounding). Re-check 2026-10-04: θ_cs = π/p is the pole pitch; it equals the geometric coil pitch 2π/Q only when Q = 2p. For D08's own 12 coils/10 poles, 12 × 36° > 360°, so non-overlapping coils must use 2π/Q = 30° (inferred; agrees with Agent 2 EQ-01/C7). Residual check (DEF-15, re-run of verification/checks/v3_geometry_resistance.py on 2026-10-04): D08 Table 4.5 p.54 states a 50 °C track temperature; at 50 °C the π/p variant gives 0.439 Ω (+12.7 %) and 2π/Q gives 0.381 Ω (−2.3 %) against D08 Table 4.6's 0.39 Ω (π/p reaches 0.393 Ω only at 20 °C, which contradicts the stated 50 °C). The residual therefore favours 2π/Q; which span the thesis model actually used is undetermined
